cause_quote: The commit added `clearChromeMcpSnapshotRefsForTarget(getChromeMcpRoutingState(target.lease.session), params.targetId)` at the start of `withChromeMcpDocument`, deleting the target’s snapshot references before each condition probe.
user_saw: After a condition wait in an existing Chrome session, a click using a still-valid element reference from the preceding snapshot failed with an unknown-reference error.
summary: The fix preserves usable snapshot references during condition waits and bundles a patched Chrome DevTools MCP runtime that rejects stale references after renderer replacement.
reasoning: The causing commit’s parent already polled through `withChromeMcpDocument` and left the existing reference map intact, so actions could still resolve references to unchanged elements after a wait. PR #153597 made the first poll delete those mappings unconditionally. The fix also addresses a separate renderer ID collision in the published MCP runtime.
